articles.title: Will FAA disruptions affect your Thanksgiving flight? What to know.
articles.summary: How your Thanksgiving travel could be affected by the recent FAA ground stop, and more ways to prepare for delays and cancellations.
articles.body:

Flight schedules across the U.S. are returning to normal after a nationwide ground stop on Friday, Nov. 13.

The Federal Aviation Administration has attributed the ground stop to a system disruption and telecommunications failure, which led to over 12,400 flight cancellations on Friday. Flights resumed Friday evening, but delays and cancellations continued throughout the weekend.

As flight schedules stabilize, millions of Americans are also preparing for Thanksgiving — one of the busiest travel periods of all year. AAA projects that 5.96 million Americans will take domestic flights over Thanksgiving.

There's no indication from the FAA that repercussions of the ground stop will continue through the holiday, but it's smart to be prepared for anything during a busy holiday travel season. Here's what travelers with flights booked this Thanksgiving should know.

Will Thanksgiving travel be affected by the FAA ground stop?

Experts say there should be little impact from Friday's nationwide ground stop on Thanksgiving travel.

"Based on the recovery updates so far, I wouldn't expect the backlog from this incident alone to carry into Thanksgiving," said Derek Cann, flight expert at Going. It will take time to get aircraft, crews, and stranded passengers where they need to be, he said, but the FAA says the system is stable.

"Friday's chaos ran into the weekend, but most airlines are back to largely normal operations [as of Monday], and Thanksgiving week should start from a clean slate," said Julian Kheel, founder and CEO of Points Path.

Kheel also predicted more stability from air travel through the holiday season. "I'd expect the FAA and its contractors to be very careful about any maintenance work during the holiday travel season. I don't think anyone's touching another router between now and New Year's."

Given the information available now, experts say, there's no reason holiday travelers should change their upcoming flights.

"I wouldn't advise canceling a Thanksgiving or Christmas trip because of this incident alone," Cann said. "The ground stop was a safety precaution. Travelers should follow official updates, but making an expensive change out of fear could leave them paying more without meaningfully improving their odds of getting there."

What travelers should know about flight delays and cancellations

There may not be a significant chance of a nationwide ground stop over the next few weeks, but holiday delays and cancellations happen every year.

"The bigger risk for your holiday trip is a snowstorm in Chicago or an airline's own computer system failing," Kheel said. "Those types of events are much more common, and can ruin your Thanksgiving trip just as easily."

If you haven't already booked your holiday flights, focus on early morning departures. Delays can build up throughout the day, and having an early flight gives you the best chance of leaving on time — or rebooking if you need to. For important events, you may also want to consider traveling a day or two earlier than you otherwise would.

"If Thanksgiving dinner is the reason for the trip, arriving a day or two beforehand can matter more than finding the perfect departure time or price (if you can swing it)," Cann said.

On travel day, you can use apps like FlightAware and Flighty to track your inbound plane, so "you can spot potential delays even before the airline announces them, helping you stay ahead of other passengers if you need to rebook or get reimbursed," said Jimmy Yoon, travel expert and head of points intelligence at point.me.

"If your flight is canceled or significantly delayed, get in every line at once, both in person and on the phone," Yoon recommended. "Go to the customer service desk, call the airline's reservations line while you wait, and check whether you can rebook yourself through the airline's app or website."

If an airline cancels your flight or significantly delays it, you may be entitled to a refund. Significant delays are defined as at least three hours for domestic flights and six hours for international flights. Refunds are only available if you don't accept another form of compensation, like a voucher or travel credit, offered by the airline, or rebook on another flight with the same airline.

articles.title: Nvidia stock valuation looks 'draconian,' even without Jensen Huang: Analyst
articles.summary: Nvidia's valuation is making some interesting assumptions.
articles.body:
When the forward price-to-earnings ratio on Nvidia ( NVDA ) is six points below that of slow-growing, struggling food giant PepsiCo ( PEP ) — as is currently the case — it's worth checking which financial assumptions are now in play on Wall Street.

UBS thinks the assumptions about Nvidia are brutal and unlikely to be correct, given the chip giant's momentum for at least two more years, even without Huang as CEO.

Nvidia stock rose 1% before the bell on Tuesday.

"In essence, the market is assuming calendar year 2028 will be the peak, there will be no growth thereafter, and EBITDA margins will compress ~1,500 basis points — this seems incredibly draconian to us," UBS analyst Tim Arcuri wrote on Monday.

Arcuri added, "We believe the near-term damage to the stock has been done and we don't think it makes sense to give up on the stock after being down this much (as some of our peers have done last week) especially ahead of January hyperscaler earnings calls where we think capex will be guided higher than current Street expectations."

Arcuri maintained a Buy rating on Nvidia's stock.

Huang was ousted as CEO of the company he founded in 1993 amid a shocking turn of events last week.

According to the New York Times , Huang, whose relationship with a woman suspected to be a Chinese spy has embroiled the company in scandal this week, also had a relationship with Nvidia executive Kimberly Powell, one of Huang's 60 or so direct reports.

Nvidia CEO Huang resigns amid affair scandals

Who is Colette Kress, Nvidia's new interim CEO?

3 challenges for a post-Jensen Huang Nvidia

Reuters reported last Thursday that Huang had a relationship with another Nvidia employee, whose name was not released. Huang has been married to his wife, Lori, for more than 40 years.

While Nvidia looks for a successor, the board has installed longtime CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO ahead of the company's earnings release on Tuesday.

Nvidia has now lost about $1.8 trillion in market value since the Oct. 6 peak.

Bank of America analyst Vivek Arya also thinks the stock has gotten too cheap.

"The stock's 11x forward PE is a multi-decade low and a ~36% forward discount to close peer Broadcom, reflecting a considerable amount of stress and potential for rebound," Arya wrote. "Any industry (DC slowdown) or company (China scrutiny, ASIC competition) concern is only likely to manifest in late calendar year 2027/2028. Our modeling indicates $15+ in calendar year 2028 estimated EPS, ~50% above current levels, even if sales flat year over year at ~$700 billion. The stock's implied 7x/11x PE on current/downside remains compelling. Importantly, even a 40% free cash flow rate (vs. consensus 50%) could translate to ~$300 billion in annual free cash flow for buybacks/ecosystem financing."

articles.title: Disney Q4 earnings beat estimates as parks and streaming keep growing
articles.summary: Disney’s fourth quarter earnings beat expectations on Tuesday before the market open, as the media giant’s parks and streaming businesses continued to delive...
articles.body:
Disney's ( DIS ) fourth quarter earnings beat expectations on Tuesday before the market open, as the media giant's parks and streaming businesses continued to deliver strong growth.

In fiscal Q4, Disney posted adjusted earnings per share of $1.77, above the $1.68 Wall Street expected, alongside revenue of $25.9 billion, which was slightly above the $25.2 billion forecast, according to Bloomberg consensus data.

Wall Street analysts have been showing confidence in the stock lately, with the stock up 15% over the past six months. On Tuesday, the stock rose 2% in premarket trading following the results.

"Our strong fiscal 2026 results, delivered amid a challenging macroeconomic environment, show we are succeeding on that mission [to be the world's leading entertainment company]," new CEO Josh D'Amaro wrote in a shareholder letter.

Total operating income for the company grew 43% year over year to $5 billion, above the expected $4.9 billion, which was the guidance Disney shared last quarter.

For the full year, the company reported revenue of $102.3 billion, alongside adjusted earnings per share of $7.02. Both metrics beat the Street's expectations of $101.5 billion in sales and $6.93 in adjusted earnings per share.

Disney also announced a 33% increase in its dividend to $2.00 per share, with $1 paid on Jan. 22, 2027, and the rest paid on July 13, 2027.

For 2027, Disney expects segment operating income to grow in the high single digits across Experiences, Entertainment, and Sports. Disney guided for double-digit growth in adjusted earnings per share, assuming "no material deterioration of the global macroeconomic environment."

For the first quarter, Disney expects total segment operating income of approximately $5.4 billion.

Parks and streaming strength drives results

Overall revenue from the Disney Experiences segment, which includes US parks and experiences and the expanding Disney Cruise Line portfolio, came in higher than expected at a record $10.1 billion, above the $9.9 billion forecast.

The company said an 11% increase in global guests, especially at Walt Disney Disneyland Paris, plus increased capacity at Disney Cruise Line following the launches of the Disney Adventure and Disney Destiny, led to the gain. Domestic parks attendance increased by 11% in the quarter.

Customers spent more at Disney parks too. Average spending per customer on admissions, food, and merchandise in US parks rose 4%, more than the expected 3.6% in the US. Internationally, sales at Disneyland Paris offset weakness in Hong Kong and Shanghai parks.

articles.title: Mais de 276 mil trabalhadores ainda não sacaram o abono salarial | G1
articles.standfirst: São R$ 304,8 milhões disponíveis para saque. Benefício é pago a quem trabalhou com carteira assinada em 2024 e recebeu, em média, até R$ 2.766 por mês. Prazo termina em 28 de dezembro.
articles.summary: São R$ 304,8 milhões disponíveis para saque. Benefício é pago a quem trabalhou com carteira assinada em 2024 e recebeu, em média, até R$ 2.766 por mês. Prazo termina em 28 de dezem
articles.body:
Mais de 276 mil trabalhadores ainda não sacaram o abono salarial de 2026. Ao todo, R$ 304,8 milhões estão disponíveis para retirada, segundo levantamento do Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego (MTE) . O prazo para receber o dinheiro termina em 28 de dezembro.

O benefício é destinado a trabalhadores da iniciativa privada e servidores públicos que atendem aos critérios do programa.

💵 O pagamento é feito pela Caixa Econômica Federal, no caso do Programa de Integração Social ( PIS ), e pelo Banco do Brasil, para quem tem direito ao Programa de Formação do Patrimônio do Servidor Público (Pasep).

Até 9 de novembro, foram pagos 26,5 milhões de benefícios, que somaram R$ 33,1 bilhões. O volume representa 98,97% do total de pagamentos previstos para o calendário deste ano.

O abono salarial de 2026 é referente ao ano-base 2024. Para receber o benefício, o trabalhador precisa cumprir os seguintes requisitos:

Estar cadastrado no PIS/Pasep há pelo menos cinco anos, contados a partir do primeiro vínculo com empregador contribuinte;

Ter recebido remuneração média mensal de até R$ 2.766 em 2024;

Ter trabalhado por pelo menos 30 dias, consecutivos ou não, durante 2024;

Ter os dados informados corretamente pelo empregador no e-Social.

Como consultar se tenho dinheiro para receber?

O trabalhador pode verificar se tem direito ao benefício, consultar o valor disponível e conferir a situação do pagamento por dois canais:

Aplicativo Carteira de Trabalho Digital;

Quem pediu revisão do benefício por meio de recurso administrativo terá os pagamentos emitidos no dia 15 de cada mês ou no primeiro dia útil seguinte.

As informações sobre os recursos podem ser consultadas a partir do dia 5 nos canais digitais do governo federal.

O pagamento é feito pela Caixa Econômica Federal ou pelo Banco do Brasil , dependendo do vínculo do trabalhador

O dinheiro é depositado prioritariamente em conta corrente, poupança ou conta digital do trabalhador, caso ele tenha uma dessas modalidades no banco.

Outra possibilidade é o recebimento pelo aplicativo Caixa Tem, por meio de uma Conta Poupança Social Digital aberta automaticamente pela instituição.

Quem não tem conta na Caixa pode sacar o dinheiro em:

Outros canais disponibilizados pelo banco.

O pagamento também é feito prioritariamente em conta bancária.

Quem não é correntista do Banco do Brasil pode receber por transferência bancária (TED), Pix ou atendimento presencial nas agências. A opção presencial está disponível para trabalhadores que não têm chave Pix.

Até quando posso sacar o abono salarial?

O prazo para retirar o abono salarial de 2026 termina em 28 de dezembro de 2026.

Quem tiver dúvidas pode procurar os canais oficiais do Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego, as Superintendências Regionais do Trabalho ou entrar em contato pelo telefone 158, da central Alô Trabalho.

articles.title: Dólar oscila na abertura, à espera de balanço da Nvidia e de olho em dados dos EUA | G1
articles.standfirst: Na véspera, a moeda americana subiu 2,15%, cotada a R$ 5,7767 e no maior valor desde abril de 2025. Já o principal índice da bolsa brasileira recuou 1,83%, aos 169.295 pontos.
articles.summary: Na véspera, a moeda americana subiu 2,15%, cotada a R$ 5,7767 e no maior valor desde abril de 2025. Já o principal índice da bolsa brasileira recuou 1,83%, aos 169.295 pontos.
articles.body:
O dólar abriu a sessão desta terça-feira (17) com volatilidade e marcava uma leve alta de 0,02% perto das 9h, cotado a R$ 5,7778 . Já as negociações do Ibovespa , principal índice da bolsa brasileira, começam às 10h.

O balanço da Nvidia fica no centro das atenções nesta terça, em meio polêmicas envolvendo a empresa e dúvidas sobre o setor de inteligência artificial. Investidores ainda acompanham dados econômicos dos Estados Unidos e seguem atentos aos sinais sobre as políticas econômica e fiscal do governo no próximo mandato.

▶️ O balanço da Nvidia está entre os destaques da sessão. Previsto para ser divulgado após o fechamento dos mercados, a expectativa é que o resultado traga novos sinais sobre o futuro da companhia e sobre os impactos do escândalo envolvendo a saída de Jensen Huang do comando da empresa , em meio a uma investigação sobre suspeitas de espionagem chinesa, no setor.

▶️ Na agenda do dia, diversos dados econômicos dos EUA ficam no radar. Além de indicadores sobre vendas no varejo, produção industrial e e preços de exportação e importação, o mercado também acompanha a divulgação do relatório semanal ADP, que mostra a evolução do emprego no setor privado do país.

▶️ No Brasil, a política fiscal continua sob os holofotes, em meio a dúvidas sobre o comprometimento do governo com o controle das contas públicas e o pacote fiscal. Saiba mais.

Veja abaixo mais detalhes do dia nos mercados.

Variação do dólar em 2026 — Foto: Arte/g1

Variação do Ibovespa em 2026 — Foto: Arte/g1

Mercado ainda vê desafios no ajuste fiscal

O Senado aprovou, na semana passada, o texto-base de um pacote de medidas do governo federal para conter o crescimento dos gastos públicos e melhorar as contas do país.

Segundo o Ministério do Planejamento, a proposta pode ter impacto de até R$ 60 bilhões em 2027: R$ 50 bilhões seriam destinados ao cumprimento das metas fiscais, enquanto outros R$ 10 bilhões abririam espaço no Orçamento para novas despesas, como o Pé-de-Meia Universitário.

limites mais rígidos para o crescimento dos gastos públicos;

possibilidade de bloquear temporariamente determinadas despesas obrigatórias;

redução de até 20% em alguns benefícios fiscais concedidos a empresas.

O texto também prevê mudanças no cálculo dos recursos mínimos destinados à saúde e estabelece um prazo para a regulamentação dos chamados supersalários do funcionalismo público.

A votação, porém, ainda não foi concluída. Quatro destaques ainda precisam ser analisados pelos senadores antes de o projeto seguir para a Câmara dos Deputados.

🔎 O objetivo do governo é conter o crescimento da dívida pública sem comprometer políticas sociais. A aprovação do pacote também é considerada importante para que o Congresso avance na votação do Orçamento de 2027.

Os resultados da Nvidia, previstos para serem divulgados nesta terça-feira (17), estão no centro das atenções dos mercados globais.

Os números podem dar novas indicações sobre o desempenho da companhia em meio à crise que levou à saída de Jensen Huang, fundador e ex-presidente-executivo da empresa.

O Conselho de Administração anunciou, na última quinta-feira (12), a saída de Huang dos cargos de presidente, diretor-executivo e integrante do colegiado. A decisão teve efeito imediato.

O fundador da Nvidia admitiu ter sido infiel à esposa após a revelação de um relacionamento com Alice Huang, empresária chinesa suspeita de atuar em uma operação de espionagem ligada a Pequim. Apesar do sobrenome em comum, ela não tem parentesco com Jensen.

Nesta terça-feira, a companhia anunciou que criou um novo comitê no nível do conselho administrativo para supervisionar suas políticas de segurança nacional, a conformidade com as normas de controle de exportação e a gestão de riscos comerciais globais.

Outro fator que ainda segue no radar e que pode ter novos impactos no setor de tecnologia é a decisão anunciada na véspera pelo presidente americano, Donald Trump . O republicano publicou uma norma que impõe novas restrições à exportação de chips avançados de IA para data centers instalados fora dos EUA.

A medida busca impedir que empresas chinesas utilizem data centers em outros países para acessar esses componentes e treinar seus próprios modelos de IA.

A norma também inclui o Brasil entre os países sujeitos às novas exigências, ao lado de Cingapura, Tailândia, Malásia e Indonésia. Com isso, a exportação de determinados chips avançados dos Estados Unidos para esses países passa a depender de autorização do governo americano. Entenda como a medida afeta o Brasil.

Na Ásia , investidores repercutiram o impacto das restrições mais rígidas dos EUA ao acesso da China a chips avançados de IA, enquanto aguardavam os resultados da Nvidia e novos sinais sobre o futuro do setor.

O SSEC , índice de Xangai, caiu 0,5%, enquanto o CSI 300 , que reúne grandes empresas negociadas nas bolsas de Xangai e Shenzen, recuou 0,1%. Já o Nikkei , do Japão, teve perdas de 1,34% e o Kospi , da Coreia do Sul, desvalorizou 2,59%. Em Hong Kong, o índice Hang Seng registrou queda de 1,03%.

articles.title: Brasileiros têm mais dificuldade para poupar que a média, diz pesquisa | G1
articles.standfirst: Pesquisa mostra que 40% dos entrevistados não conseguem poupar ou investir, acima da média global de 32%. Especialistas explicam como começar a organizar o orçamento.
articles.summary: Pesquisa mostra que 40% dos entrevistados não conseguem poupar ou investir, acima da média global de 32%. Especialistas explicam como começar a organizar o orçamento.
articles.body:
Chegar ao fim do mês com algum dinheiro sobrando é uma realidade distante para muitos brasileiros. Quatro em cada 10 pessoas no país dizem que não conseguem poupar ou investir , segundo uma pesquisa da Allianz realizada em maio de 2026. O percentual é maior do que a média global, de 32%.

Outros 8% dos entrevistados no Brasil afirmaram não ter renda própria. Esse grupo aparece separado dos que dizem não conseguir guardar dinheiro.

🐖 Mas por que é tão difícil fazer uma reserva? A resposta passa pelo valor gasto com as despesas básicas, com dívidas e pelos juros altos. Também envolve a maneira como as famílias organizam o orçamento e lidam com o consumo.

Falta de renda e custo de vida estão entre as principais preocupações

A dificuldade para guardar dinheiro aparece em meio a outras preocupações com as contas. No levantamento, divulgado pela Allianz em parceria com a Ipsos, metade dos brasileiros (50%) apontou as finanças como uma das três áreas da vida que mais preocupam .

A pesquisa Personal Worries também perguntou quais outros assuntos tiram o sono da população. Saúde aparece em primeiro lugar, mencionada por 58% dos entrevistados, seguida por finanças (50%), segurança (37%), trabalho e carreira (32%) e futuro (31%).

Quando o assunto é dinheiro, dois problemas se destacam: a insuficiência de renda e o aumento do custo de vida. No Brasil, as duas preocupações aparecem praticamente empatadas.

Na comparação com a média global, os brasileiros demonstram preocupação maior com a insuficiência de renda e menor com o aumento do custo de vida e a capacidade de poupar para o futuro.

É importante separar os dois levantamentos: o estudo de maio investigou a situação financeira e a capacidade de poupança; o de junho perguntou quais áreas da vida mais preocupam os entrevistados.

Percepção da situação financeira — Foto: g1

Despesas básicas e dívidas deixam pouco espaço para guardar dinheiro

Para muita gente, o salário já chega com destino certo . Aluguel, supermercado, transporte, contas de água e luz e outras despesas essenciais consomem boa parte da renda.

A pesquisa da Allianz ajuda a dimensionar essa dificuldade: 18% dos brasileiros dizem enfrentar muita dificuldade para atender às necessidades básicas. Outros 28% afirmam que conseguem cobrir esses gastos, mas com dificuldade .

Para as famílias de menor renda, guardar dinheiro muitas vezes não é uma questão de planejamento, mas de falta de condições. Quando o salário é consumido por despesas como moradia, alimentação e transporte, não há margem para formar uma reserva.

O professor Marcos Piellusch, da FIA Business School, ressalta que, nesses casos, a restrição de renda é o principal obstáculo.

“Para uma parcela grande da população, a renda mal cobre despesas essenciais como moradia, alimentação, transporte e contas básicas, e não sobra nada para poupar”, afirma.

A situação fica ainda mais apertada quando há dívidas. Parte do salário que poderia ser usada para guardar dinheiro acaba comprometida com o pagamento de juros. Piellusch lembra que o crédito caro no Brasil agrava esse quadro, especialmente para quem já tem parcelas e contas atrasadas.

Com a Selic em 13,75% ao ano e cerca de oito em cada 10 famílias com algum tipo de dívida, segundo os números citados pelo professor, o custo dos empréstimos também pesa no orçamento.

Se para as famílias de menor renda o principal obstáculo é conseguir pagar as contas, para quem tem alguma folga no orçamento a organização financeira também faz diferença.

➡️ Um erro comum é esperar o mês terminar para só então tentar guardar o que sobrou. Entre compras, contas e pequenos gastos do dia a dia, o dinheiro costuma acabar antes.

“O brasileiro costuma poupar o que sobra no fim do mês, quando o mais eficaz seria separar o valor logo que o salário cai”, diz.

As compras parceladas e o uso frequente do cartão também podem atrapalhar. Uma parcela isolada pode parecer pequena, mas várias compras feitas ao longo dos meses comprometem uma parte cada vez maior dos salários futuros. E nem sempre as famílias sabem exatamente quanto gastam por mês.

Quando a renda aumenta, é comum elevar o padrão de vida : trocar de carro, morar em um imóvel maior, viajar mais ou consumir produtos e serviços mais caros. São gastos que podem se transformar em compromissos fixos e reduzir o espaço para economizar.

🔎 O professor chama esse movimento de “inflação do estilo de vida”. A comparação com amigos e pessoas do mesmo círculo social também pode influenciar as escolhas de consumo.

No Brasil, famílias de renda mais alta ainda precisam lidar com despesas particulares elevadas, como escola, plano de saúde e segurança privada. Esses custos, segundo Piellusch, também limitam o quanto conseguem guardar.

Ele pondera que poupar 20% da renda de forma consistente já é um patamar razoável pelos parâmetros internacionais. O desafio, nesse caso, está em manter a regularidade e investir o dinheiro pensando no longo prazo.

Baby Boomers têm mais dificuldade para poupar do que Millennials

A idade também ajuda a explicar por que algumas pessoas conseguem guardar dinheiro e outras não.

Na pesquisa da Allianz, metade dos entrevistados da geração Baby Boomer (50%) afirmou não conseguir poupar atualmente. Entre os Millennials, o percentual foi de 38%.

“Os Millennials estão hoje na fase de maior acumulação, com renda em ascensão, carreira consolidada e, em muitos casos, mais acesso a informação e a plataformas digitais de investimento”, explica Piellusch.

Para os mais velhos, a conta pode ser diferente. A renda tende a diminuir depois da aposentadoria, enquanto despesas com saúde e medicamentos aumentam. Muitos também continuam ajudando financeiramente filhos e netos.

Há ainda uma diferença histórica: os Baby Boomers formaram seus hábitos financeiros durante a hiperinflação brasileira. Naquele período, deixar dinheiro parado significava perder rapidamente o poder de compra. Por isso, parte dessa geração priorizou a compra de imóveis em vez de aplicações financeiras.

A diferença, portanto, não pode ser explicada apenas por hábitos individuais. As condições econômicas e as necessidades de cada fase da vida também pesam.

Como começar a poupar e o que fazer quando há dívidas

Para quem chega ao fim do mês sem conseguir guardar nada, o primeiro passo é descobrir para onde o dinheiro está indo. A recomendação de Piellusch é anotar todas as despesas durante um ou dois meses, inclusive os pequenos gastos.

➡️ Assinaturas pouco usadas, tarifas bancárias, planos de celular e internet acima do necessário e compras parceladas que se acumulam são alguns exemplos de despesas que podem ser revistas.

Depois de entender os gastos, a orientação é separar uma quantia assim que o salário entrar na conta. Mesmo que seja pouco, criar o hábito é mais importante do que começar com um valor alto

➡️ O 13º salário, a restituição do Imposto de Renda e trabalhos eventuais também podem ajudar a dar o primeiro passo. O dinheiro reservado deve ficar em uma aplicação segura, com possibilidade de resgate diário, separada da conta usada para as despesas do cotidiano.

A primeira meta pode ser juntar o equivalente a um mês de gastos essenciais. Com o tempo, o objetivo é ampliar a reserva para cobrir de três a seis meses dessas despesas.

Mas quem está endividado precisa tomar alguns cuidados antes de pensar em acumular dinheiro. Na maioria dos casos, a prioridade deve ser quitar as dívidas mais caras, como o rotativo do cartão de crédito e o cheque especial, cujos juros podem passar de 400% ao ano.

“Manter dinheiro aplicado enquanto se paga esse custo significa, na prática, perder dinheiro todos os meses”, afirma o professor.

Isso não significa ficar sem nenhuma proteção. Piellusch recomenda manter uma pequena quantia para imprevistos e direcionar o restante para as dívidas com juros mais altos. Também vale tentar uma renegociação, buscar descontos ou trocar uma dívida cara por outra mais barata.

Depois de resolver os débitos mais pesados, o dinheiro que antes era usado para pagar parcelas pode ser direcionado à reserva de emergência. Sem esse colchão, uma despesa inesperada pode levar a família novamente ao crédito caro e iniciar outro ciclo de endividamento.

articles.title: Ansiedade climática atinge produtores rurais após enchentes no RS | G1
articles.standfirst: Insônia, aperto no peito e medo de cada nova chuva: psiquiatra explica por que quem vive da terra é mais vulnerável aos efeitos emocionais da crise do clima.
articles.summary: Produtores rurais do RS relatam traumas e o impacto da ansiedade climática na saúde mental de quem tenta reconstruir a vida após as históricas enchentes no estado.
articles.body:
Dois anos e meio após as enchentes de 2024, as terras da produtora de leite Angelita Hermes, em Vera Cruz , no Rio Grande do Sul, estão verdes de novo. Mas houve um tempo em que ela caminhava por ali e não enxergava nada disso. Foi quando entendeu que precisava de ajuda.

“Quando eu percebi que eu quase não tinha mais chão aqui, quando eu percebi que, caminhando no meu pátio, que hoje está tudo verde, tudo bonito, eu não via mais o verde”, conta.

O sofrimento que Angelita descreve já tem nome. Especialistas chamam de ansiedade climática o medo de que a mudança do clima transforme o lugar onde a pessoa vive e trabalha. No campo, onde o sustento depende do sol e da chuva na hora certa, esse medo deixou de ser uma preocupação passageira e virou sofrimento concreto.

Os números ajudam a explicar por quê. Nos últimos 32 anos, foram registrados mais de 60 mil desastres climáticos em municípios brasileiros.

Só no Rio Grande do Sul, que há dois anos e meio viveu o maior desastre climático da sua história, quase 50 municípios decretaram emergência por falta de chuva em março deste ano. Em novembro, os temporais atingiram mais de 130. É água que falta e sobra no mesmo ano.

A psiquiatra Ana Sfoggia, que coordena o Núcleo de Vulnerabilidade Climática e Ambiental da PUC-RS, diz que a ansiedade climática pode afetar qualquer pessoa, principalmente numa época de consumo desenfreado de informação, mas que quem vive da terra é mais vulnerável .

“Eles são os primeiros a perceber as variações, porque trabalham com o clima, com a terra, com os animais. Eles enxergam isso antes de todo mundo”, explica.

Expressões como ecoansiedade e solastalgia também são usadas para descrever a mesma condição. “É uma tentativa de nomear as emoções, porque quando a gente tem o nome, não se sente tão sozinho”, diz a psiquiatra.

Em agosto, um tornado com ventos de mais de 300 km/h varreu Pedro Osório , no sul do estado. A casa do agricultor Leonardo Ferreira estava no caminho.

“Tu vê tudo que a gente constrói com sacrifício, trabalhando, e chegar e ver tudo no chão é difícil”, lamenta.

O agricultor Leonardo Ferreira já tomava remédio para depressão e ansiedade por causa de sequelas da Covid. Depois do tornado, precisou voltar ao tratamento.

“A ansiedade e a angústia não deixavam dormir mais. Hoje, quando arma um tempo mais feio, tu não sabe se vem um tornado, uma chuva de granizo ou só uma chuva. Fica com o coração na mão.”

Íris Weber olha pela janela de sua casa: 'Eu não gosto de olhar para o rio. Parece que ele vem assombrar a gente'. — Foto: Globo Rural

Em Muçum , no Vale do Taquari, a família Weber tenta reorganizar a vida depois de duas enchentes, uma em setembro de 2023 e outra em maio de 2024. O rio corre a poucos passos da propriedade, e dona Iris Weber não consegue mais olhar para ele.

“Eu não gosto de olhar para o rio. Parece que ele vem assombrar a gente. [...] Quando o rio enche, a gente fica mais angustiado, com mais medo. Então, eu não fico observando. Eu desvio o olhar.”

O filho, Felipe, que hoje cuida da lavoura, encontrou outro jeito de lidar com o medo: vigiar o Taquari pelo celular. Ele estuda quais cidades deságuam no rio e quanta chuva é preciso para a água chegar a cada nível. Mas o excesso de informação também cobra seu preço.

“Nos períodos chuvosos, para conseguir dormir, a gente tem que estar acompanhando o nível do rio. E quando ele está subindo, o nosso sono é pior”, conta.

A insegurança já aparece na lavoura. Em anos normais, o milho para silagem já estaria plantado nesta época. “As enchentes dão uma desanimada. Será que vale a pena continuar investindo nosso tempo de novo? Nem por dinheiro, mas por ter um futuro na vida”, diz Felipe, que decidiu procurar um psicólogo.

“Começa com uma negação: será que precisa? Mas eu quebrei esse paradigma. Estou no início do tratamento, mas já percebi que ajuda.”

articles.title: Aneel pode decidir nesta terça sobre caducidade da concessão da Enel-SP | G1
articles.standfirst: A expectativa é que o colegiado acompanhe o voto da relatora e recomende a caducidade da concessão.
articles.summary: A expectativa é que o colegiado acompanhe o voto da relatora e recomende a caducidade da concessão.
articles.body:
A Agência Nacional de Energia Elétrica ( Aneel ) volta a se reunir nesta terça-feira (17) para discutir o processo que pode resultar na recomendação de caducidade da concessão da Enel SP, distribuidora responsável pelo fornecimento de energia na capital paulista e em municípios da Região Metropolitana.

Segundo apurou o g1 , a expectativa é que o colegiado acompanhe o voto da relatora e recomende a caducidade da concessão . Se isso ocorrer, a decisão seguirá para o Ministério de Minas e Energia (MME), que dará a palavra final sobre o encerramento antecipado do contrato.

O processo se tornou um dos casos mais sensíveis já analisados pela agência reguladora. Desde 2023, a atuação da Enel em São Paulo passou a ser acompanhada de perto pela Aneel, autoridades locais e consumidores, após uma sequência de apagões de grandes proporções que deixaram milhões de pessoas sem energia por períodos prolongados.

Em seu voto, acompanhado pela diretora-substituta Ludimila Lima da Silva, a relatora apontou que todos os instrumentos regulatórios disponíveis- para que a concessionária melhorasse o serviço prestado- já foram usados.

"A recomendação de caducidade decorre da constatação de que todos os instrumentos regulatórios disponíveis à Aneel foram esgotados na tentativa de fazer com que a concessionária corrigisse as falhas ao atendimento em situações de emergência", escreveu a diretora.

Tida como uma medida extrema, a caducidade (ou extinção do contrato) pode ocorrer quando confirmado que a concessionária descumpre obrigações contratuais e não tem condições de manter a prestação de serviços à população.

Ao longo do processo, a Enel vem contestando as conclusões da fiscalização. A concessionária sustenta que sua resposta aos eventos climáticos vem melhorando e afirma que os indicadores de atendimento emergencial evoluíram nos últimos anos.

articles.title: India faces 'acute' aircraft shortage, needs more than 1,000 planes: Piyush Goyal
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: India is looking to add another 1,000 civilian aircraft to its existing orders as it struggles to keep up with rising air traffic demand amid
articles.body: NEW DELHI: India is looking to add another 1,000 civilian aircraft to its existing orders as it struggles to keep up with rising air traffic demand amid an "acute" shortage of planes, Union minister Piyush Goyal said.The government is also pushing established aircraft manufacturers to speed up supplies.Speaking to reporters during his two-day visit to Egypt, Goyal said expanding the aircraft fleet would help improve air connectivity between the two countries and create room for more flights."We need to see more (air) connectivity... as we get more aircraft, we are sure we will be able to have more flights to Egypt," he said.Goyal is in Egypt to explore opportunities to strengthen trade and investment ties between the two countries. Currently, EgyptAir operates direct flights connecting India and Egypt.Pointing to the scale of India's aircraft requirements, the minister said the country had already ordered more than 1,200 planes but would need over 2,000 aircraft to meet its requirements. It is now prepared to place orders for another 1,000 planes, while pressing manufacturers to ensure quicker deliveries."We have ordered more than 1,200 planes, and we are ready to order another 1,000 planes; we need more than 2,000 planes for our requirements. So we are pursuing the established manufacturers of aircraft for faster supplies," Goyal said.He reiterated that the arrival of more aircraft would allow Indian airlines to operate additional flights to Egypt.India is one of the world's fastest-growing civil aviation markets, with airlines IndiGo and Air India having placed substantial aircraft orders with Airbus and Boeing for deliveries in the coming years.The country is also seeing the presence of several major international aerospace companies. Airbus has two final assembly lines in India, catering to military transport aircraft and helicopters.Global aircraft manufacturers Boeing and Airbus also source components and services worth around $2 billion every year from India. Meanwhile, Brazilian aircraft maker Embraer has partnered with the Adani Group under a strategic collaboration to explore setting up regional aircraft manufacturing in India.Money habits form by age 7. articles.title: Trump’s Nvidia stake grew to as much as $62 million: Report
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump has stood by Nvidia’s former boss Jensen Huang despite a string of personal scandals, including an affair with an alleged
articles.body: US President Donald Trump has stood by Nvidia’s former boss Jensen Huang despite a string of personal scandals, including an affair with an alleged Chinese spy.But there is another Nvidia connection drawing attention: Trump's own stock portfolio.His investments in the AI chipmaker have grown sharply over the past year, with financial disclosures suggesting that his stake could be worth as much as $62 million.The disclosures put Trump's Nvidia holdings under the spotlight as the company grapples with controversy surrounding Huang's resignation and its business dealings with China.Trump's Nvidia stakeTrump’s Nvidia holdings, estimated at between $615,000 and $1.3 million at the end of 2024, rose to as much as $62 million within the last year, according to financial disclosures reviewed by The Washington Post. However, these filings do not include trades made over the past two months, so the latest value of his holdings could be even higher, The Independent reported.But the value of his holdings is only part of the picture. Since returning to the White House, Trump's investment accounts have been actively buying and selling Nvidia shares.A CNBC analysis of his annual and periodic financial disclosures found that his accounts had bought or sold Nvidia shares at least 103 times. The transactions were worth a combined $27 million to $97.5 million.The exact size of Trump's current stake, however, remains unclear. His disclosures report investments in broad dollar-value ranges rather than the actual number of shares held. Based on the holdings reported in August, his Nvidia investment would have been worth between $4.5 million and $57.7 million by midday Monday, when the stock was trading at around $157.The latest disclosures do not capture transactions from the past two months, making it difficult to establish how much Nvidia stock Trump currently owns.Trump's investment accounts sold between $500,001 and $1 million worth of Nvidia shares on May 18, the first Monday after his return from a China visit with Huang. The sale was part of a wider trading spree, with Trump disclosing more than 21,000 trades in 2025, compared with roughly 500 during his entire first term, according to CNBC's analysis.White House response to questions over Trump's Nvidia holdingsThe scale of Trump's Nvidia investments has also raised questions about his financial interests in the company, particularly given his close relationship with Huang and his administration's decisions on export controls.The administration has opened the door for Nvidia to do business in China, while Trump has repeatedly defended its approach to export restrictions against criticism. These decisions have come under scrutiny as the company faces questions over its China-related business and the allegations surrounding Huang.White House officials have repeatedly maintained that Trump does not personally select or trade individual stocks. The president has also rejected calls to sell his stock holdings.According to the White House, Trump's assets are held in a trust managed by his children, while independent financial managers handle his investment portfolio.‘She may not be a spy,’ says TrumpTrump has also appeared to question his administration's assessment of Alice Huang's alleged links to Chinese intelligence.“I don’t know that she’s a spy at all. Nobody's proven that,” he told reporters outside the White House on Monday. “He probably shouldn’t have been doing, on a personal basis, what he did. You know, from — who knows? That's a different story. But nobody's proven that she's a spy. She may not be a spy,” he said.Nvidia shares were trading at around $157.72 on Monday, down more than 3.1% during the day. The decline came as investors reacted to Huang's resignation ahead of the company's third-quarter earnings call scheduled for Tuesday.Huang stepped down last Thursday following revelations about his relationship with Alice Huang, a Chinese businesswoman and an executive at Megaspeed, a Singapore-based Nvidia customer, who is suspected of being a spy.Money habits form by age 7. Anil Kumar Bhansali, head of treasury at Finrex Treasury Advisors LLP, attributed the decline to growing concerns about a global supply surplus. The International Energy Agency has projected a surplus of around 2 million barrels per day in the fourth quarter, with Middle Eastern crude shipments through the Strait of Hormuz recovering faster than expected. Weakening demand from China has added to the pressure on prices.The currency could continue to find support from softer oil prices and foreign fund inflows, although gains may face some resistance from a stronger dollar and rising US bond yields."We expect the rupee to trade with a positive bias on easing inflation concerns amid softening crude oil prices and strength in the domestic markets. articles.title: Meta tightens Instagram content recommendations in India amid government scrutiny
articles.summary: Meta Platforms has modified Instagram's recommendation systems in India to reduce the amount of sexually suggestive and violent content shown to users, as
articles.body: Meta Platforms has modified Instagram's recommendation systems in India to reduce the amount of sexually suggestive and violent content shown to users, as the government steps up oversight of online platforms and their content policies.The changes, announced by the company on Tuesday, apply to recommendations from accounts that users do not follow. Meta said they affect what Instagram promotes rather than imposing a blanket ban on the content itself, according to Reuters.The announcement comes after the Indian government asked Meta last month to review how its systems recommend posts and strengthen checks on material that could incite violence or disrupt public order.Meta said it had improved its default protections over the past year in response to user feedback. It also said people in India now report seeing recommended content about half as often as they did a year ago, but did not provide figures to support the claim.The company did not directly link the latest changes to the government's advisory.Government flags risks from recommendation systemsIn an advisory dated October 10, the ministry of electronics and information technology asked Meta to review its ranking and recommendation systems to ensure that potentially misleading, manipulated or out-of-context material was not disproportionately amplified.The ministry also asked the company to ensure users were not disproportionately exposed to a single narrative or a limited set of viewpoints, and to report the measures taken to address these concerns, according to Reuters.The government's concerns extend beyond the content hosted on social media platforms to the systems that determine what users see.The advisory sought greater scrutiny of how recommendation mechanisms amplify material and shape users' exposure to different narratives.Meta faces wider scrutiny over content on its platformsThe latest changes come amid broader scrutiny of Meta's handling of harmful content, including child sexual exploitation material, on Facebook and Instagram.Last month, Meta said that it had taken action against 5.3 million pieces of child sexual exploitation content on its platforms in India between January and June 2026. More than 98% of the material was detected proactively, the company said, according to news agency PTI.Meta also said it had introduced additional measures to strengthen its efforts to tackle such content.The disclosure followed government concerns over the company's handling of child sexual abuse material and its responsibilities as an intermediary.Officials had warned that Meta could risk losing the legal protections, commonly referred to as safe harbour, available to intermediaries if it failed to meet its obligations.The government had also raised concerns about the role of Meta's recommendation and advertising systems, arguing that these mechanisms gave the company responsibilities beyond simply hosting content posted by users.Separately, the National Commission for Protection of Child Rights had warned Meta representatives during an inquiry into alleged advertisements linked to child sexual exploitation and abuse material on the platform.Meta India chief Arun Srinivas and other senior executives appeared before the panel as part of the inquiry.Meta has previously changed content-ranking systems on Facebook in countries including Canada and Brazil to reduce the amount of political content recommended to users.Money habits form by age 7. articles.title: US reveals how Megaspeed came under scrutiny and landed on Nvidia's 'no sell' list in 2025
articles.summary: Nvidia's partnership with Singapore-based cloud-computing company Megaspeed hit a roadblock in June 2025, when the chipmaker put it on its \"no sell\" list.
articles.body: Nvidia's partnership with Singapore-based cloud-computing company Megaspeed hit a roadblock in June 2025, when the chipmaker put it on its "no sell" list. The decision came after US investigators sought details of Nvidia's direct and indirect sales to its Asia-Pacific partner, according to information released by the US commerce and justice departments on Monday.The US investigation, however, had started much earlier, in 2024, after authorities flagged suspicious activity linked to the possible diversion of sensitive semiconductors.The commerce department approached Nvidia in May 2025, seeking records of direct and indirect sales to Megaspeed. A month later, the company found itself on Nvidia's restricted sales list, the two departments said in a joint statement.The agencies said the probe was triggered by suspicious activity detected through monitoring of potential semiconductor diversion."After identifying suspicious activity through proactive monitoring of potential sensitive semiconductor diversion, the department of commerce initiated an investigation into Megaspeed in 2024 for potential export control violations," the agencies said, as cited by Reuters.The investigation moved beyond records and sales checks in June 2025, when US agents travelled to Megaspeed's premises with Singaporean law enforcement officials. They carried out an "on-site, in-person, end-use check at Megaspeed" and questioned Alice Huang, who was then the company's chief executive.The Justice Department subsequently took charge of the criminal investigation into Megaspeed, following the enforcement action.The two departments said they were making details of the case public despite the usual practice of not commenting on ongoing investigations, citing public interest.Megaspeed's dealings with Nvidia are not the only aspect of the company drawing suspicion. Its former executive Alice Huang, a Chinese businesswoman, has also come under scrutiny, with some US authorities suspecting links to Chinese espionage efforts. However, Beijing has continued to refute the allegations.The allegations gained attention following reports that Nvidia's former CEO Jensen Huang had an affair with Alice Huang. Jensen resigned from Nvidia on November 12. en unable to reach Alice Huang for comment.Megaspeed said on Sunday that Alice Huang formally left the company on August 30, 2025. It also maintained that it had conducted a "legitimate and lawful business."Singapore's government had said last week that Alice Huang previously held three key positions at Megaspeed — chief executive, chairperson and one of its key controllers.Police found insufficient evidence to establish that she had committed offences related to suspected false declarations over server purchases. However, they warned her for knowingly providing inaccurate information that played down her role in the company.Singapore has barred Alice Huang from re-entering the country. Investigations involving Megaspeed and six other individuals are still underway, the home affairs ministry said.Meanwhile, Singapore's government said on Monday that it had agreed to continue discussions with Washington over the company.Money habits form by age 7. The IRGC blamed what it called the “blatant aggression” of the US military for the attack.Iranian Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf said Iran will not remain in a state of “neither war nor peace.”Meanwhile, the United States has deployed a third aircraft carrier, the USS Theodore Roosevelt, a nuclear-powered carrier, to the Middle East. The carrier has joined two other aircraft carriers, USS George Washington and USS George H.W. Bush, already operating in the region. The US deployment has raised concerns that Iran-US peace talks may not resume anytime soon.Iran's Deputy Foreign Minister Gharibabadi warned that Iran will not wait for the US to attack first.Iran continues to stick to its demands, including the unfreezing of its assets, an end to wars on all fronts, the lifting of the US blockade, and a formal announcement ending the war to facilitate the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.US President Trump, while ruling out fresh strikes, continues to pressure Iran through economic constraints.Elsewhere, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said US peace envoys have floated a deal under which Ukraine would cede the Donbas region to Russia in exchange for NATO membership. He added that Ukraine is discussing with its partners a comprehensive security package modelled on Article 5 of the North Atlantic Treaty as an “absolute minimum.”Brent oil futures, following two straight weeks of losses, were down more than 2% at $93.47 at the time of writing. Data roundup:The US Empire State Manufacturing Index fell from 25.5 in October to 7.8 in November, compared with the estimate of 18.China's retail sales rose 0.4% y-o-y in October, below the forecast of 0.8% and the prior month's 1.1% growth. The Iran war could emerge as one of the key geopolitical issues on the agenda.There is also a possibility of the first-ever trilateral meeting between Trump, Xi and Putin.Fedspeak:Fed Chair Warsh, in opening remarks at a Fed conference focused on the productivity and labour-market implications of technology on November 16, said AI will have a significant impact on the economy and eventually have important implications for monetary policy. articles.title: Smartphones, TVs, refrigerators and daily essentials set to get costlier after Diwali as companies pass on rising input costs; handset prices have already risen over 40% this year
articles.summary: It’s time to prepare for a squeeze on your household budgets as companies prepare to hike prices with the Diwali festive season over.
articles.body: It’s time to prepare for a squeeze on your household budgets as companies prepare to hike prices with the Diwali festive season over. Consumer goods companies are gearing up for another round of price increases across smartphones, televisions, refrigerators and daily-use products as they grapple with rising input costs and seek to safeguard their margins.With the festive season now behind them, manufacturers are looking to recover the accumulated cost burden through higher retail prices and reductions in product grammage, potentially adding to the pressure on household budgets.Daily essentials to cost moreThe pressure is mounting on fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) manufacturers. Companies in the sector are preparing to raise prices to offset increases in the cost of refined palm oil, sugar, milk and packaging laminates, all of which became up to 7% more expensive sequentially in the previous quarter.Britannia Industries has signalled additional price increases and cuts in pack sizes for its Rs 5 and Rs 10 products. Tata Consumer Products has also increased prices of salt, sauces and condiments, with the revised rates expected to reach the market soon. These moves come after Amul raised milk prices and ITC increased cigarette prices last week.Britannia chief executive Rakshit Hargave told ET that the company had implemented a 3.5% price increase in the previous quarter, while also reducing the quantity in fixed-price packs. “There is more price increase in activation which is in the works,” he told analysts earlier this month. “It is going to come, and that is something that we have to do.”Electronics prices to go upSamsung and Xiaomi, two major smartphone brands, raised prices of their handsets and tablets by up to 18% over the weekend. Xiaomi announced a separate increase of up to 7% in television prices on Monday. Appliance manufacturers Haier and Godrej have also raised prices by up to 7% across their product ranges.“Raw material prices continue to remain elevated and sustaining profitability is becoming an issue,” Haier India chief executive Satish NS was quoted as saying by the financial daily. “Sales are growing healthily upwards of 20%, but profits are taking a bad hit.”He noted that the industry's previous round of across-the-board price increases took place in September. Most listed consumer goods companies had reported pressure on margins in the first half of FY27 as commodity prices continued to climb. They were unable to pass on the entire increase in costs to buyers because they wanted to protect demand.Companies now expect the next round of price increases to improve profitability by transferring the full impact of higher costs to consumers.The latest round of increases comes as consumer demand faces fresh challenges, particularly in the smartphone segment. Kailash Lakhyani, chairman of the All India Mobile Retailers Association, said mobile phone sales by volume have fallen 40% after Diwali compared with the corresponding period last year. This follows a 20% year-on-year decline during Diwali itself, after multiple rounds of price increases over the course of this year.“The current price increases will further dent demand,” he said. “Getting a sub-20,000 5G phone has now become difficult, which will badly impact sales.”Industry executives expect electronic brands across the board to raise prices over the coming 7-10 days.If implemented, the impending increases would take the total price rise this year to more than 40% for smartphones, over 20% for televisions and 15-20% for household appliances.Kamal Nandi, business head (appliances) at Godrej Enterprises Group, said manufacturers had consciously held back the increases until the festive season was over.The factors driving higher costs differ across product categories.Smartphone and television manufacturers are dealing with a sharp rise in memory chip prices, as demand from AI infrastructure continues to exceed available supply.Appliance makers, by contrast, are contending with higher commodity and freight expenses. FMCG companies are facing mounting costs of edible oil, sugar, milk and packaging materials.Money habits form by age 7. Is your child learning the right ones? Join the TOI Money Masterclass.

articles.title: Tata group stocks rally up to 9% after RBI nudges Tata Sons to comply with listing norms
articles.summary: With the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) refusing to grant exception to the listing of Tata Sons, shares of the group’s companies rallied on Tuesday.
articles.body: With the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) refusing to grant exception to the listing of Tata Sons, shares of the group’s companies rallied on Tuesday. Shares of several Tata Group companies climbed on Tuesday after RBI directed Tata Sons to adhere to all applicable regulations for upper-layer non-banking financial companies (NBFCs).These include the requirement for the holding company of the salt-to-software conglomerate to list its shares.Tata Sons has been classified as an upper-layer non-banking financial company (NBFC) since 2022. In July 2025, Tata Trusts, which exercises control over 66% of the holding company through the Sir Ratan Tata Trust and the Sir Dorabji Tata Trust, passed a resolution favouring the continuation of Tata Sons as a privately held entity.Tata Group shares rallyTata Chemicals surged 9%, while Tata Investment Corporation advanced more than 3%. Shares of Tata Motors and Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles rose around 2% each.Tata Chemicals owns a 2.53% stake in Tata Sons, valued at Rs 30,052.2 crore. Tata Investment Corporation's shareholding in the holding company is worth more than Rs 950 crore. Given these substantial investments, shares of both companies are particularly exposed to developments concerning the proposed Tata Sons IPO.Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles and Tata Steel each own slightly more than 3% of Tata Sons, with their respective holdings valued at around Rs 36,348 crore. Tata Power and The Indian Hotels Company (IHCL) have stakes ranging between 1% and 2%.The gains followed the emergence of a letter from the central bank to Tata Sons' chief financial officer, intensifying pressure on the holding company to go ahead with its long-awaited initial public offering (IPO), which it has resisted for years, according to an ET report.“While specific guidance has not been sought on any particular regulation/ guideline/ direction, from the discussion in the board regarding listing, it seems the guidance is perhaps with respect to the same,” RBI said in its letter.“You are advised to comply with all applicable regulations/ guidelines/ directions, issued by RBI in respect of NBFCs in the upper layer (NBFC-UL), as stipulated in extant regulations/ guidelines/ directions hosted on the RBI's website, including the requirement of listing by your company,” the central bank added in the letter dated November 16.Will Tata Sons list?Earlier, in September this year, RBI turned down Tata Sons' application to voluntarily surrender its Certificate of Registration (CoR) and move to the category of an unregistered Core Investment Company (CIC). The rejection cleared the way for a potential public listing of the holding company of India's largest business conglomerate, whose operations span multiple sectors and countries.A possible listing of Tata Sons could also give the Shapoorji Pallonji Group an opportunity to unlock the value of its approximately 18% stake in the company. The debt-laden group has been exploring ways to monetise a portion of this holding to repay part of its estimated Rs 60,000 crore debt.(Disclaimer: Recommendations and views on the stock market, or any other asset classes or personal finance management tips given by experts and analysts are their own. articles.title: 8th Pay Commission: Indian Railways employees seek two extra days for talks, while defence civilians demand Rs 69,000 minimum pay, 3.83 fitment factor and OPS restoration
articles.summary: 8th Pay Commission news: The All India Railwaymen's Federation (AIRF) has requested an additional two days with 8th Pay Commission chairperson Ranjana
articles.body: 8th Pay Commission news: The All India Railwaymen's Federation (AIRF) has requested an additional two days with 8th Pay Commission chairperson Ranjana Prakash Desai to discuss matters concerning railway employees across several categories, including medical personnel, traffic department staff, ministerial employees and supervisors in technical departments.Separately, the All India Defence Employees’ Federation (AIDEF) is scheduled to meet the 8th Pay Commission on November 18. Discussions are expected to cover salaries, pensions, allowances, insurance and other matters affecting employees.In a letter dated November 12, 2026, AIRF secretary general Shiva Gopal Mishra sought a further two-day appointment with the commission to take up various employee-related issues.The railway employees' federation has already held discussions with the 8th Pay Commission, with its most recent meeting taking place on October 31. It had also submitted its memorandum to the commission on October 10 this year.According to an ET report, in its latest communication, AIRF listed the employee categories it wants to discuss at the proposed meeting:Medical department: All non-gazetted categories of railway medical employees.Supervisory staff in technical departments: Supervisors across all technical departments of Indian Railways, including drawing and design personnel, CMT staff, Depot Material Superintendents (DMS) and the Information Technology (IT) cadre.Traffic department: All non-gazetted employees in the department, including Controllers and other categories, except train managers.Ministerial staff: Ministerial cadres, excluding accounts personnel, along with stenographers, staff and welfare inspectors, and works study inspectors.Accounts and miscellaneous categories: Accounts employees and other miscellaneous categories of railway staff.Other railway establishments and specialised categories: Employees of Metro Railway, Kolkata, the Research Designs and Standards Organisation (RDSO), Rajbhasha categories and other such groups.AIRF has argued that the categories it has identified account for a significant portion of the railway workforce and have specific job responsibilities and service-related concerns. It said their views must also be adequately represented before the commission so that their legitimate demands receive proper consideration under the 8th Pay Commission (CPC).“Accordingly, we request that at least two additional days may kindly be earmarked for detailed discussions on the above-mentioned categories, at a date and time convenient to the Hon'ble Chairperson and the Commission,” the AIRF wrote.AIDEF demands from 8th Pay CommissionThe All India Defence Employees’ Federation (AIDEF), which represents around 50,000 civilian defence employees, is scheduled to meet the 8th CPC on November 18. The federation intends to press for an end to the disparity between railway employees and civilian defence personnel in pay scales and promotion opportunities. It argues that civilian defence employees require a high level of skill and work under hazardous conditions.C Srikumar, general secretary of AIDEF, shared with ET a list of demands he intends to raise during the meeting with the pay commission. These include:Minimum pay: Set the minimum salary at Rs 69,000, using a fitment factor of 3.83 and a five-unit family as the basis for calculation.Promotions: Ensure a minimum of five promotions or Assured Career Progression (ACP) benefits over 30 years of service.Risk and hardship allowance: Provide an allowance of Rs 10,000 per month.Group insurance: Increase the insurance cover to Rs 1 crore for Group C employees, Rs 1.5 crore for Group B employees and Rs 3 crore for Group A employees.Compensation for death on duty: Provide ex-gratia compensation of Rs 2 crore to employees killed in accidents while on duty.Compassionate appointments: Make compassionate appointments available in 100% of eligible cases.Medical facilities: Provide cashless medical treatment, including access to the latest medical and surgical procedures.Pension scheme: Withdraw the National Pension System (NPS) and Unified Pension Scheme (UPS), and restore the Old Pension Scheme (OPS).Pension revision: Revise pensions for those who retired before January 1, 2026, restore the commuted portion of pension after 12 years and increase pensions every five years.Money habits form by age 7. articles.title: Gold hit a lifetime high near Rs 1.80 lakh per 10 grams in January 2026; 10 months later, MCX gold is down about 25% while silver has crashed nearly 60% from its Rs 4.20 lakh/kg peak
articles.summary: Gold price crash: At the start of 2026, investors of gold and silver were a happy lot.
articles.body: Gold price crash: At the start of 2026, investors of gold and silver were a happy lot. Ten months later, gold and silver prices have crashed spectacularly from their lifetime highs.Gold prices edged higher on Tuesday but continued to hover close to a more-than-one-year low recorded in the previous session, as a stronger US dollar and rising expectations of a Federal Reserve interest rate hike next month weighed on the precious metal.The metal had fallen to its lowest level since October 2025 on Monday. US gold futures for December delivery also advanced, rising 0.6% to $3,876.70 per ounce.Also Read | Predicted to hit Rs 2 lakh, will gold prices fall to Rs 1.25 lakh per 10 grams?The dollar climbed to a fresh 19-month high on Tuesday, making gold priced in the US currency costlier for buyers using other currencies.Among other precious metals, spot silver advanced 1.1% to $47.50 per ounce after touching its lowest level since late October 2025 in the previous session.Platinum prices rose 1.2% to $1,467.29 per ounce, while palladium gained 0.8% to $976.58.Gold And Silver Fall in NumbersIn the domestic market, MCX Gold is currently trading at Rs 1,34,884 per 10 grams down 0.4% so far this year and 25.4% or Rs 45,895 below its lifetime high of Rs 1.8 lakh.MCX Silver, currently at Rs 1,69,292, has declined 28.2% year to date and is 59.7% or Rs 2,50,756 below its lifetime high of Rs 4.2 lakh per kg.According to CME's FedWatch tool, markets are pricing in a 95.4% probability of a 25-basis-point interest rate increase in December. The likelihood of a larger, 50-basis-point hike stands at 4.6%.Higher interest rates raise the opportunity cost of holding gold, which does not generate income, making the precious metal less attractive to investors.Investors are now looking to the minutes of the Federal Reserve's latest Open Market Committee meeting, scheduled for release on Wednesday, for indications of the likely direction of US monetary policy."Gold is trading as a function of expectations for US Fed policy next year and the market trying to work out how high interest rates in the States can go," said Kyle Rodda, senior financial market analyst at Capital.com."Essentially, the big selloff we saw last night in gold is a reflection of that and today's bounce is just a slight reversal of it,” Rodda was quoted as saying by Reuters."Demand has stayed resilient so far, but mounting macro headwinds could erode investment demand, leaving the market without a key pillar of support," analysts at ANZ said in a note."Silver remains a high-beta play on gold. With its own demand fundamentals soft, any sustained rebound will depend on a gold recovery," the note added.Gold prices have retreated from the record highs reached in January this year, with several factors contributing to the decline.The initial slide came as investors booked profits after the metal climbed to elevated levels, triggering a sharp fall in prices. Before gold could find its footing, the US-Iran war broke out, pushing crude oil prices above $120 per barrel and intensifying concerns over inflation.More recently, a sharp and unprecedented rise in real yields has put gold under considerable selling pressure. The US Federal Reserve has raised interest rates for the first time since 2023. With inflation remaining elevated, expectations of further rate increases in the coming months have also strengthened.The shift in the Fed's stance, from considering rate cuts to raising interest rates, has supported the US dollar. Higher yields have made US bonds more appealing to investors, increasing the opportunity cost of holding gold. Since the precious metal does not pay interest, its attractiveness diminishes when investors can earn higher returns from bonds.Money habits form by age 7. Is your child learning the right ones? Management’s priorities are to scale healthcare manufacturing, grow its institutional and diagnostics network, bring technology-led products to market and establish a lasting presence in the US, UK and other international markets. articles.title: Foreign investors may increase bets on Indian financial stocks as flows recover: Jefferies
articles.summary: Foreign portfolio investors (FPIs) have considerable scope to increase their exposure to India's financial sector, as their holdings in the segment remain
articles.body: Foreign portfolio investors (FPIs) have considerable scope to increase their exposure to India's financial sector, as their holdings in the segment remain below the five-year average, brokerage firm Jefferies said in a report.The assessment comes as foreign investment flows into Indian equities have turned positive since mid-October, with net buying reaching $11.4 billion so far. Of this, FPIs bought shares worth $9.6 billion in November so far, alongside a sharp rally in banking stocks.Jefferies said the relatively low positioning of overseas investors in financial stocks leaves room for further buying as foreign flows recover.“Financials relative positioning for FPIs is below average, leaving room for catch-up,” the brokerage said.According to the report, at the end of the September 2026 quarter, FPIs' relative overweight position in financials was 2.3 percentage points below the five-year average and 6.2 percentage points below the peak recorded in March 2023.Foreign ownership in BSE 500 hits 12-year lowThe recent return of foreign buying follows two years of outflows, which brought FPI ownership in the BSE 500 to a 12-year low of 17.3% as of September 2026, Jefferies said.In contrast, domestic institutional investors (DIIs) increased their shareholding in the BSE 500 to 18.8%, the highest level in 12 years, supported by sustained inflows.Promoters held a 48.5% stake in the index, down two percentage points from the peak recorded in June 2024. Direct individual ownership remained unchanged at 8.5%.The brokerage also highlighted the role of non-India-dedicated active funds, which accounted for 63.8% of the total $691 billion in FPI assets under custody as of September 2026.Jefferies said these funds could raise their allocations to Indian equities given their relatively light positioning.FPIs remain underweight in several sectorsBeyond financials, foreign investors were overweight in healthcare by 0.2 percentage points and real estate by 0.1 percentage points.However, they remained underweight across other sectors, with the largest gaps in energy at 1.7 percentage points, consumer staples at 1.3 percentage points and consumer discretionary at one percentage point.The report said large-cap stocks had led the latest market rally. Since mid-October, the Nifty 100 has gained 9%, compared with a 4% rise in mid-cap stocks and a 2% increase in small-cap stocks.Among large-cap companies, 60% of those with an FPI-to-DII ownership ratio above one outperformed the Nifty 100, Jefferies said.The brokerage said a sustained recovery in foreign investment flows could benefit large-cap stocks disproportionately. It reiterated its preference for large-cap shares over small- and mid-cap stocks.Money habits form by age 7. Is your child learning the right ones? Join the TOI Money Masterclass.

articles.title: ONGC initiates well-control operations after gas leak in Andhra village
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: State-run Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited (ONGC) on Tuesday said it had initiated necessary well-control operations following a leak
articles.body: NEW DELHI: State-run Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited (ONGC) on Tuesday said it had initiated necessary well-control operations following a leak reported at a gas well in Andhra Pradesh’s BR Ambedkar Konaseema district early on Tuesday.The company, in a statement, said it had promptly cordoned off the area within a radius of 500 metres and evacuated residents.Traffic on the affected stretch of National Highway 216 had been diverted, a temporary shutdown of the local power supply had been arranged to minimise potential ignition risks and a water blanket had also been established as a precautionary measure, it said. No injuries had been reported.The leak was reported at around 5am during workover operations in Geddada village. According to reports, nearly 800 people had been evacuated.“ONGC Rajahmundry asset promptly activated the disaster management team. The emergency response team rushed to the site and initiated appropriate safety and well-control measures. The disaster management plan was activated, and additional personnel, equipment and resources were mobilised from the regional crisis management facilities at Narsapur,” ONGC said, adding that it was maintaining close coordination with the district administration and state authorities to facilitate an effective response.The company said that zero gas concentration was detected at the well site during the assessment.Money habits form by age 7. articles.title: Jorge Garbajosa en el Business Sport Forum: "La nuestra es una propuesta que traerá paz y consenso"
articles.standfirst: El presidente de FIBA Europa abrió el gran encuentro de la industria deportiva con un diálogo para resumir el proyecto de nueva competición continental que impulsa junto a la NBA
articles.summary: El presidente de FIBA Europa abrió el gran encuentro de la industria deportiva con un diálogo para resumir el proyecto de nueva competición continental que impulsa junto a la NBA
articles.body: Jorge Garbajosa fue el primer gran protagonista de la cuarta edición del Expansión & Marca Business Sport Forum, celebrado en el Espacio La Salle de la madrileña calle San Juan de la Salle. El presidente de FIBA Europa, bajo el título 'El baloncesto europeo ante su próxima etapa de crecimiento', y en diálogo con Jesús Sánchez, jefe de sección de MARCA, repasó la actualidad de su deporte, con especial atención a la nueva competición continental que se pretende poner en marcha. "Todo esto parece una revolución, pero es lo contrario: se trata de volver a las raíces. No es una competición nueva por un tema de poder o de espacio, sino que se trata de relanzar el baloncesto europeo. De que vuelva a lo que no debió dejar de ser. Ahora ya da igual lo que se ha hecho bien o se ha hecho mal, pero una competición de unos pocos clubes no puede decidir los designios de todos, es de sentido común. No parece descabellado que el que gane una Liga se tenga que clasiifcar para la mejor competición, pero es que hay cosas muy normales que en el baloncesto han dejado de serlo. Tampoco es un tema romántico, que también, sino de números e inversiones", desarrolló Garbajosa. "Hemos negociado dos años con la Euroliga pidiendo cosas sencillas: respetar las ventanas de las selecciones nacionales, que las Ligas nacionales clasifiquen y un calendario que funcione para deportistas y aficionados. No fuimos capaces de ponernos de acuerdo y tenemos que asumir todos nuestra parte de culpa. Si yo quiero invertir y no tengo posibilidad de llegar a competición internacional, ¿para qué voy a hacerlo? Es una cuestión de meritocracia", insistió, recordando que la NBA Europa comenzaría con 12 franquicias y cuatro clubes que conseguirían su puesto atendiendo a criterios deportivos. El presidente de FIBA Europa se fijó también en los plazos: "Es un reto arrancar en 2027. ¿Me gustaría? Sí ¿Me quita el sueño? No. Sin haber empezado el paradigma ya ha cambiado, pero para pasar de A a B hay mucho que negociar y muchos contratos que hacer. En lo que respecta a los clubes, interés han tenido todos. Están dispuestos a hablar, pero arrancar una competición de la nada requiere un tiempo. Y en realidad no es una competición, es un ecosistema entero para dar cabida a muchos países. Todos los que participen tendrán los mismos derechos y obligaciones. Garbajosa entiende que sólo hay dos actores imprescindibles para el baloncesto: "Deportistas y aficionados. Respecto a los primeros, no pueden jugar tres o cuatro veces por semana. Cada partido debe contar, no puede ser jugar por jugar. El hijo de un amigo estaba triste porque su equipo había perdido un partido, pero luego se dio cuenta de que en cuanto a la competición no pasaba nada por haberlo perdido. Eso no puede ser. Y hay que conjugar también los intereses de las Ligas nacionales, que son nuestro cocido de cada día". Respecto a las franquicias de la nueva competición, señaló que corresponde a la NBA el anuncio público: "Me hace mucha gracia que por ejemplo Londres parezca exótico, cuando venimos de una Supercopa de Euroliga que se ha jugado en las mismas fechas de las Ligas, en Abu Dabi y participando el Dubai. La NBA lleva 40 años generando beneficios multitudinarios que redundan en todos los actores, mientras que aquí se sigue sufriendo. Yo quiero hablar de mi libro, no del libro de otros, pero... ¿por qué ahora el nuevo plan de la Euroliga? ¿por qué parece que va a llover el dinero justo en este momento? La realidad es tozuda y hemos entrado en una espiral que no es positiva. Estamos en noviembre y, si no fuera por esto que se está creando, ya podría decir quién va a jugar el año que viene en Europa". Jorge, que no añora su etapa como jugador ("este lado de la mesa es apasionante; trae muchas noches sin dormir, pero es un privilegio presidir NBA Europa"), dejó un deseo final: "Esta es una propuesta de paz y de consenso, para unir a Federaciones, Ligas y clubes. Si sale como tiene que salir, además de pasión e inversión, traerá estabilidad". Su intervención había servido para abrir un foro patrocinado por la Comunidad de Madrid, IFEMA Madrid, Iberdrola, Unicaja, LaLiga, Ariete, Cellnex, DAZN y Philip Morris España, y en el que la bienvenida había corrido a cargo de Ana Isabel Pereda, directora de EXPANSIÓN, y de Juan Ignacio Gallardo, director de MARCA, con discurso institucional de Alberto Tomé, director general de Deportes de la Comunidad de Madrid. A través de su director de Desarrollo de Negocio de Banca Privada y Banca Personal, Javier López de Heredia Sánchez, Unicaja quiso por último hacer entrega de una cápsula del tiempo a Garbajosa, que en su día vistió esos colores. Porque, como dice su lema, 'el futuro también se entrena'.
